sloka: त्रिशिरो वक्षसि क्रुद्धो निजघान चतुर् दश ।चतुर्भिः तुरगान् अस्य शरैः संनत पर्वाभिः ॥३-२७-१४॥
transliteration: triśiro vakṣasi kruddho nijaghāna catur daśa ।caturbhiḥ turagān asya śaraiḥ saṁnata parvābhiḥ ॥3-27-14॥

translations.english: With four arrows having strong joints, the mighty hero (Rama) threw down his enemy's four swiftfooted horses.
